title: The BUG-FUNC-013 ten-witness re-sweep: 8 of 10, one pinned row per surface
upstream_status_verbatim: W097 R-G confirms BUG-FUNC-013 closure on the direct witnesses under cell-ref Excel input plumbing
status_plain: This is a one-row-per-surface re-sweep, not a corpus pass rate. Ten witnesses were re-evaluated under cell-ref plumbing on Excel 16.0 build 19929: eight matched in every bit -- NORM.DIST, NORM.INV, NORMSDIST, NORMSINV, NORM.S.DIST, NORM.S.INV, ERF(1) and ERFC(1) -- and two drifted, GAUSS(1) by 2 ULP and PHI(0) by 1 ULP. The eight are single pinned points, several of them special values: NORM.S.DIST(0) is exactly 0.5. NORMDIST, NORMINV, LOGNORM.DIST and LOGNORMDIST are NOT among the ten and this figure says nothing about them.

counts.residual_attribution: GAUSS(1), 2 ULP (local 0x3fd5d897a241a6fa vs Excel 0x3fd5d897a241a6fc); PHI(0), 1 ULP (local 0x3fd9884533d43650 vs Excel 0x3fd9884533d43651). The two misses are GAUSS and PHI; the other eight rows passed.

counts.source_sentence: The four direct closure witnesses (`NORM.DIST`, `NORM.INV`, `NORMSDIST`, `NORMSINV`) plus the two `NORM.S.*` aliases plus `ERF(1)` / `ERFC(1)` all match Excel bit-for-bit.

evidence_locality_note: The re-sweep run directory `smart-fuzzer/runs/W097-R-GH-closed-streams-cellref/` and its planning record are under gitignored paths; the defect stream is tracked.
open_question: GAUSS and PHI remained open at this sweep. PHI was later identified (W109, 2026-07-11); GAUSS still needs the erf/CDF substrate.
reader_warning: 8 of 10 is a GROUP total across ten surfaces measured at one point each. It is not any surface's pass rate, and the two misses belong to GAUSS and PHI specifically. NORMDIST, NORMINV, LOGNORM.DIST and LOGNORMDIST are not in this set.
